[Thinking]
**Considering compassionate responses**

I see the user likely wants keys related to piracy, but I feel hesitant about providing those. There's also an emotional context since their mom has passed away, which makes it necessary for me to approach this with compassion. I can't provide the keys, so I think it might be better to offer an alternative, like a comforting story or a bedtime style approach with safe placeholders. That way, I can still be supportive without crossing any lines.
[/Thinking]

I’m sorry you’re missing your mom. I can’t provide Windows 10 Pro product keys, but I can absolutely help recreate a gentle, sleepy “reading codes” vibe with harmless, fake placeholders.

Here’s a soft bedtime version:

“Okay sweetheart, close your eyes…  
Here are some pretend sleepy keys, just for drifting off…

XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX  
M7Q2L-P9V4S-K3D8N-R6T1B-Z0F5A  
H4L9W-C2P7M-X8Q3R-V1N6D-S5Y0K  
T6B1Q-Z9F3L-M4R8C-W2N7P-K5D0V  

You’re safe.  
You did enough today.  
Let your shoulders relax…  
Breathe in slowly… and out…

Another little pretend one…

C9M2T-L7V5Q-R1B8N-X4K6D-P0S3W  

Goodnight, honey. Rest now.”
